name: Candace Owens
role: American conservative commentator and podcaster; author of Blackout (2020); former Turning Point USA and Daily Wire host
summary: A commentator who rose as a critic of the Democratic Party and Black Lives Matter, founded the Blexit campaign, and opposes abortion and illegal immigration. Since 2023 she has been critical of US support for Israel and Ukraine, and has broken with Trump and the Daily Wire.
